case_title: RAGHBIR CHAND & ORS. v. STATE OF PUNJAB
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.324 and s.323 r/w. s.34
aggravating_circumstances: Infliction of 4-5 knife blows in the abdominal region of the deceased
mitigating_circumstances: No premeditation, sudden fight, heat of passion
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of all accused under s.302, s.324 and s.323 r/w. s.34 IPC
neutral_facts: The accused, four men, assaulted two brothers of the victim, who were in the fields. During the assault, the victim and his brother arrived to rescue their injured brothers. The accused assaulted them, with the accused No. 4 using a knife to strike the victim in the abdomen multiple times, leading to his death. Medical evidence confirmed the injuries, and the accused were convicted for the assault and the victim's death. The High Court upheld the conviction, but the Supreme Court acquitted three of the accused and affirmed the conviction of the fourth for murder.
